title: Credential Harvesting Phishing Email
raw_alert: A user forwarded an email with the subject 'Urgent: mailbox will be suspended today'. The sender address is support-notice@micros0ft-security.example. The message says the user's mailbox storage is over quota and asks them to verify the account within 30 minutes at https://login-microsoft-security.example/verify. The email includes threatening language and asks for the user's password and MFA code.
